m08_86.say: When purchasing commercial real estate, conducting an initial environmental site review is one of the most critical due-diligence steps you can take before closing. Unlike a structural inspection, an initial review does not involve drilling or lab testing; instead, environmental consultants review historical records to identify potential contamination risks. For instance, they examine historical city directories and fire insurance maps to see whether dry cleaners, auto repair shops, or chemical warehouses once operated on the property. If those records reveal any red flags, I always advise buyers to commission a follow-up soil and water test—which involves physical soil and groundwater sampling—before waiving their inspection contingency.

m08_157.text:
Adaptive Reuse: Turning Obsolete Malls into Green Logistics Hubs

Across North America, real estate investment companies are increasingly acquiring underperforming suburban shopping malls and redeveloping them into last-mile fulfillment centers. — [1] — While traditional new undeveloped-land warehouse construction often faces fierce community opposition over habitat loss and urban sprawl, repurposing existing retail sites leverages already-paved land and established highway interchanges.

— [2] — "Demolishing a 900,000-square-foot mall generates massive landfill waste," explains Dr. Hannah Cho, an urban sustainability researcher at Pacific Institute. "By retaining the existing concrete slab and primary structural steel where feasible, developers cut carbon emissions by as much as 45 percent." — [3] —

However, these conversions are rarely straightforward. Retail ceilings are typically 14 to 18 feet high, whereas modern automated logistics operators demand clear heights of at least 32 feet to accommodate high-bay racking. — [4] — As a result, engineers frequently have to raise the roof trusses or selectively dismantle interior upper platforms, adding significant structural complexity to the retrofit.

AEROSEAL DUCT SEALING SYSTEM — COMMERCIAL SERIES
In typical commercial office buildings built before 2005, leaky heating and cooling ductwork wastes up to 30% of conditioned air before it ever reaches occupied zones. AeroSeal's patented aerosol-based sealing technology seals leaks from the inside out—without requiring contractors to tear down drywall ceilings or disrupt daily tenant operations.

How It Works:
1. Supply and return registers are temporarily blocked, and the system is pressurized.

4. A computer-generated certificate documents exact before-and-after air leakage rates.

Ideal for hospitals, schools, and occupied Class A office towers. Zero harmful fumes and full compliance with national energy standards.

• 解析：對話提到冷藏庫、裝卸碼頭與 this logistics distribution center，對應 (B) A commercial freight and warehousing building（商業貨運與倉儲建築）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 冷藏區只是該物流中心的一部分，並非製造工廠；(A) 消防官只是來巡檢；(D) 錯把石膏板修補當成建材行。

questions.q: What issue did the safety inspector point out?
options: Protective wall panels were absent in an exit stairway.
The contractor's punch list omitted the northeast loading dock.
The dock levelers failed to pass the morning test.
Cold-storage bays were not ready for occupancy by Monday.

explain.text:
• 考點：問題細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：消防檢查官指出東北側樓梯間管線井周圍缺少防火石膏板（fire-rated drywall was missing... in the northeast stairwell），對應 (A) Protective wall panels were absent in an exit stairway。
• 誘答分析：(C) 原文說 dock levelers 測試正常；(D) 是尚待取得核可，非確定無法進駐；(B) 兩人正要將此項列入 punch list，並非原本就漏列碼頭。

questions.q: What will the woman do immediately after the conversation?
options: Phone the drywall crew to schedule repairs
Obtain final sign-off from the fire marshal
Test the loading dock levelers one more time
Take visual documentation of the unfinished area

explain.text:
• 考點：緊接行動題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：女士說談話結束後要馬上去樓梯間拍下外露框架的照片（take photos of the exposed framing），對應 (D) Take visual documentation of the unfinished area。
• 誘答分析：(A) 打給石膏板班組是男士要做的事（A/B 人物錯置陷阱）；(B) 還沒修好無法取得最終簽核；(C) 碼頭已測試完畢。

questions.q: What are the speakers trying to decide?
options: Whether to trench through the concrete floor next year
How to upgrade the basement electrical room at Oakwood Plaza
Which contractor should install the landscape island
The best location for vehicle-recharging equipment

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨決定題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：女士說最後一項是決定電動車充電樁要裝在哪裡（where to place the new electric vehicle charging stations），對應 (D) The best location for vehicle-recharging equipment。
• 誘答分析：(B) 他們討論的是裝充電樁的位置，而非如何全面升級地下室配電室；(A) 開挖混凝土是升級變壓器的代價，非討論主題；(C) 只是提到景觀島旁的備用電源，未討論包商評選。

questions.q: What concern does the man raise about the underground garage?
options: Utility approval for a secondary feed takes four months.
It is not sheltered from heavy rain.
Its current power supply is nearly maxed out.
Tenants rarely park near the basement electrical room.

explain.text:
• 考點：擔憂細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：M2 指出地下室現有變壓器容量已接近上限（existing transformer capacity there is already near its limit），對應 (C) Its current power supply is nearly maxed out。
• 誘答分析：(B) 地下室反而能遮雨，遮雨是優點；(A) 等四個月是升級地下室變壓器所需時間，不是戶外備用電源；(D) 原文是租戶主動要求裝在地下室。

questions.q: What do the speakers agree to do?
options: Install six chargers in the underground garage first
Ask tenants whether they prefer the north surface lot
Wait four months until the main transformer is upgraded
Place the initial charging units in an open-air parking area

explain.text:
• 考點：共識決定題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：三人同意先在北側戶外平面停車場安裝 6 座 Level 2 充電樁（install the Level 2 chargers in the outdoor lot first），對應 (D) Place the initial charging units in an open-air parking area。
• 誘答分析：(C) 他們選擇先裝戶外，不等四個月；(A) 地下室明年再議；(B) 未提議做租戶調查。

questions.q: Why is the woman calling the man?
options: To check if a scheduled construction task is still proceeding
To ask why the foundation crew is arriving at 6:30 A.M.
To complain about weak concrete from an earlier pour
To report that the ready-mix plant canceled tomorrow's order

explain.text:
• 考點：來電目的題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：女士打來確認明天早上 7 點的主樓板混凝土澆置是否照常進行（confirm whether we're still on for the main slab concrete pour），對應 (A) To check if a scheduled construction task is still proceeding。
• 誘答分析：(D) 預拌廠並未主動取消；(B) 6:30 A.M. 是改期到週四的時間；(C) 混凝土強度變弱是暴雨澆置的潛在風險，非過去事件。

questions.q: Why does the man mention the weather forecast?
options: Mild temperatures on Thursday may cause honeycombing.
The radar indicates the storm will end before 7:00 A.M.
Predicted precipitation would damage the fresh material.
Clear skies tomorrow morning will speed up the curing process.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題 + 上位概念改寫。
• 解析：男士提到氣象預報明天上午 8 點起下大雨，女士回應大雨會破壞收光並影響養護（ruin the surface finish and compromise the curing process），對應 (C) Predicted precipitation would damage the fresh material。
• 誘答分析：(A) 週四氣溫溫和是好天氣，不會造成蜂窩現象；(D) 晴朗天空是週四，非明天；(B) 大雨會持續到下午，不會在 7 點前結束。

questions.q: What does the woman agree to do?
options: Send the foundation crew home until mid-afternoon
Cancel the mixer trucks without setting a new time
Call the weather service for an updated Thursday radar
Contact the supplier to move the delivery to a later day

explain.text:
• 考點：同意行動題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：男士提議將預拌車改期至週四早上，女士回答馬上打給調度員鎖定週四上午（call the dispatcher right now and lock in Thursday morning），對應 (D) Contact the supplier to move the delivery to a later day。
• 誘答分析：(A) 未提到讓工班回家待命；(C) 她是聯絡調度員而非氣象局；(B) 有明確改期至週四，並非無期取消。

questions.q: What is the woman's role at Apex Properties?
options: Environmental initiatives executive
Corporate finance analyst
Maplewood Towers building engineer
Smart thermostat calibration specialist

explain.text:
• 考點：身分推論題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：女士自稱 Apex Properties' Sustainability Director（永續長），對應 (A) Environmental initiatives executive。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 均為對話中提及的其他角色或部門（building engineers、Finance、calibration）。

questions.q: What does the man say about the smart thermostat pilot program?
options: It fell short of the twelve-percent reduction goal.
It lowered high-demand electricity usage significantly.
Sensor calibration delayed the three-month trial.
All twelve office properties have already installed it.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：男士說自動化溫控排程讓尖峰時段用電量下降 18%（cut our peak-hour energy consumption by eighteen percent），對應 (B) It lowered high-demand electricity usage significantly。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原文是超越 12% 目標，非未達標；(C) 僅有輕微校正調整，未延誤試辦；(D) 目前僅在 Maplewood Towers 試辦，尚未全面導入 12 棟大樓。

questions.q: What does the woman want to include in next week's presentation?
options: A list of minor calibration tweaks made by engineers
Financial estimates of the system's expected profitability
A comparison of energy use across Maplewood Towers
Carbon-reduction data from the past twelve months

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：女士想在下週簡報納入全面導入後的預估投資報酬率數據（projected return-on-investment figures），對應 (B) Financial estimates of the system's expected profitability。
• 誘答分析：(A) 工程師的輕微校正不需放進董事會簡報；(D) 試辦期為三個月，非十二個月；(C) 是評估擴展至 12 棟物業的財務回報。

questions.q: Why is the man hesitant about signing the sublease agreement?
options: His architecture studio has not submitted its financials yet.
The seventh-floor rent is not competitive enough.
The outgoing tenant altered the partition walls without permission.
A required approval from the property owner is still missing.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：男士猶豫是因為草約規定須大房東書面同意（master landlord's written consent is required）且尚未看到簽署文件，對應 (D) A required approval from the property owner is still missing。
• 誘答分析：(B) 男士稱讚租金有競爭力；(A) 財務資料是接下來要提交的，非猶豫主因；(C) 復原條款是針對租期結束時，並非前租戶擅自改動。

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "It's standard boilerplate"?
options: The building owner rarely enforces the restoration clause.
Initialing the draft does not make the sublease take effect.
Section 12 applies only to architecture studios in this city.
That contract provision is typical wording in local agreements.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（It's standard boilerplate）。
• 解析：女士接著說這座城市幾乎每份商業租約都包含復原條款（Nearly every commercial lease in this city includes a restoration clause），即 (D) That contract provision is typical wording in local agreements。
• 誘答分析：(C) 並非只適用建築事務所；(A) 並未說房東很少執行；(B) 須由大房東簽署才生效，非此句本意。

questions.q: What will the man likely do next?
options: Consult an attorney regarding one part of the contract
Ask the master landlord to remove Section 12
Hire a contractor to restore the partition walls
Sign the sublease agreement before submitting financials

explain.text:
• 考點：推論未來行動題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：男士最後說還是想請自家法務顧問審閱第 12 條再草簽（having our legal counsel review Section 12 before I initial anything），對應 (A) Consult an attorney regarding one part of the contract。
• 誘答分析：(B) 他是先給法務看，未說要求刪除第 12 條；(D) 明確說在法務審閱前不會草簽；(C) 復原隔間牆是租期結束的事。

questions.q: What project are the speakers working on?
options: Replacing steel trusses in an existing city hall
Planning a sustainable municipal reading facility
Preparing a client presentation on steel manufacturing
Inspecting timber beams at a fire-safety lab

explain.text:
• 考點：專案主題題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：男士開場提到「節能公共圖書館設計進度（energy-efficient public library design）」，對應 (B) Planning a sustainable municipal reading facility。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原文未提市政廳；(D) 僅提到要跟消防局確認，非在實驗室檢驗；(C) 週五向客戶簡報的是圖書館設計，非鋼鐵製造。

questions.q: Why did the design team choose engineered wood?
options: It does not require approval from the fire marshal.
It costs forty percent less than conventional steel.
It lowers the structure's environmental footprint.
It eliminates the need for a roof truss system.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題 + 上位概念改寫。
• 解析：男士指出選用工程木材比傳統鋼構減少近四成碳排（cuts the building's carbon emissions by nearly forty percent），對應 (C) It lowers the structure's environmental footprint。
• 誘答分析：(B) 40% 是減碳比例，非成本節省（數字張冠李戴陷阱）；(A) 仍須與消防局確認；(D) 木材正是用於屋頂桁架系統。

questions.q: What does the woman say she needs to check with the fire marshal?
options: Whether extra fireproofing is required for the steel trusses
Whether the structural team can present on Friday
Whether uncovered timber elements meet safety regulations
Whether the main atrium needs additional ceiling sprinklers

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：女士說她明天要向消防局確認外露木樑的消防安全合規性（fire-safety compliance for the exposed beams），對應 (C) Whether uncovered timber elements meet safety regulations。
• 誘答分析：(D) 未提挑高中庭灑水頭；(B) 與消防局無關；(A) 本案已改用工程木材，非鋼構桁架。

questions.q: Why does the woman suggest adjusting the upgrade sequence?
options: The law firm on the third floor is moving out next week.
The heating contractor cannot meet the August 20 deadline.
Insulated windows for the East Wing have not arrived yet.
Loud installation work is bothering current building tenants.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：女士指出換窗涉及大量鑽孔噪音，東翼仍有 60% 進駐率且三樓法律事務所已抱怨干擾（complained about disruptions），對應 (D) Loud installation work is bothering current building tenants。
• 誘答分析：(A) 法律事務所仍在駐，未搬走；(B) 暖氣包商反而是下週有空檔可提前；(C) 未提窗戶延遲到貨。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which wing's estimated completion date will likely be moved up?
options: South Wing
West Wing
North Wing
East Wing

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽力線索 + 表格欄位）。
• 解析：女士在對話中不直接說出翼棟名稱，僅給出線索「目前進駐率最低（僅 40%）、排定安裝太陽能熱泵（solar heat pump）、目標為 August 20」的那一區可提早完工。對照表格，40%、Solar Heat Pump、August 20 唯一對應 (A) South Wing。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆為表格中其他翼棟，必須聽懂對話線索並交叉比對圖表才能選出正解。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to send him?
options: A revised timeline for the work crews
Contact information for both contractor teams
The complaint letter from the third-floor law firm
Occupancy figures for the summer renovation

explain.text:
• 考點：請求行動題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：男士請女士在確認日期後寄給他更新後的包商排程（the updated contractor schedule），對應 (A) A revised timeline for the work crews。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆挪用對話出現過的 law firm、occupancy、both teams 製造誘答。

questions.q: What is the man's main priority when selecting an office suite?
options: Finding a unit that already has thirty workstations
Ensuring complimentary underground parking for twelve staff
Keeping the monthly base rent as low as possible
Securing enough room to accommodate future hiring

explain.text:
• 考點：主要考量題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：男士說公司三年內人員將倍增，因此「保留未來擴編空間（room for future expansion）」是首要考量，對應 (D) Securing enough room to accommodate future hiring。
• 誘答分析：(C) 他明確說這比壓低租金（keeping rent as low as possible）更重要；(A) 只是該單元可容納 25–30 個座位，非男士優先尋找已擺好 30 張桌子的單位；(B) 地下停車須另外計費。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which suite is the man most interested in touring?
options: Suite 401
Suite 402
Suite 403
Suite 404

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽力線索 + 表格欄位）。
• 解析：對話中不直接唸出房號，而是提供線索：女士推薦「面積最大（largest unit）、面河岸採光（riverfront exposure）」，男士補充「即使月租超過一萬一千美元（over eleven thousand dollars）也要先看這間」。對照表格，4,200 sq. ft.、West / Riverfront、$11,340 唯一對應 (D) Suite 404。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 皆為表格中其他辦公室編號，面積與租金皆不符合線索。

questions.q: What does the woman say is included in the base rent?
options: Reserved parking spaces in the underground garage
Custom workstation setup for consulting firms
Use of a communal meeting venue on the top level
Afternoon utility credits for riverfront units

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：女士說明地下停車另計，但所有租戶可免費使用共享的屋頂會議中心（complimentary access to our shared rooftop conference center），對應 (C) Use of a communal meeting venue on the top level。
• 誘答分析：(A) 停車另行收費（billed separately）；(B)(D) 將對話中的 consulting firm、afternoon light 與 riverfront 錯置。

questions.q: What trend does the woman highlight about the third quarter?
options: Hot weather drove up expenses for chilled-water air conditioning.
Onsite solar credits fell short of offsetting daytime cooling costs.
Grid electricity expenses climbed steadily from Q1 to Q3.
Natural gas bills rose due to the record summer heatwave.

explain.text:
• 考點：趨勢細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：女士指出第三季區域冷卻水費用因破紀錄夏季熱浪而大幅攀升（district cooling water costs rose... because of the record summer heatwave），對應 (A) Hot weather drove up expenses for chilled-water air conditioning。
• 誘答分析：(C) 電網用電與天然氣成本反而是 Q1 到 Q3 穩定下降；(D) 上漲的是冷卻水，不是天然氣；(B) 原文強調太陽能抵減很有幫助，並未說不足。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. How much did onsite solar offset save the building during the quarter the woman refers to?

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽力線索 + 表格數值）。
• 解析：男士在對話中未直接說出「Q2」或「$6,800」，而是指明「在區域冷卻水費用首次突破九千美元的那一季（when our cooling water bill first climbed above nine thousand dollars）」。對照表格，District Cooling Water 在 Q1 為 $5,000、Q2 首次突破九千達 $9,200，該季（Q2）的 Onsite Solar Offset 為 -$6,800，對應 (B) $6,800。
• 誘答分析：(A) 為 Q1 太陽能抵減；(C) 為 Q3 太陽能抵減；(D) 為 Q3 冷卻水費用，皆來自圖表數值。

questions.q: What does the man propose for next year's budget?
options: Increasing the capacity of the building's solar power system
Reducing daytime cooling in the third quarter
Switching from district cooling water to natural gas
Reviewing the Q1 utility summary before allocating capital

explain.text:
• 考點：提案題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：男士提議在明年的資本預算中擴建屋頂太陽能陣列（expanding our rooftop solar array），對應 (A) Increasing the capacity of the building's solar power system。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 皆挪用對話中的 daytime cooling、district cooling water、natural gas、Q1、capital 等字詞設計錯誤選項。

questions.q: Who is the intended audience for this announcement?
options: Technicians repairing the building's elevators
Members of the facilities engineering team
Municipal diesel-equipment inspectors
Occupants of a commercial office property

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾身分題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：開頭稱呼 all tenants of Northbridge Corporate Tower（商辦大樓租戶），對應 (D) Occupants of a commercial office property。
• 誘答分析：(B) 設施工程團隊是執行測試者；(C) 挪用 municipal 與 diesel；(A) 挪用 elevators。

questions.q: What will happen between 9:00 A.M. and 1:00 P.M. on Saturday?
options: All elevators will be transferred to municipal grid power.
The building's auxiliary power system will undergo testing.
Diesel fuel will be delivered to Northbridge Corporate Tower.
Standard office lighting will be shut off for four hours.

explain.text:
• 考點：活動細節題 + 上位概念改寫。
• 解析：週六上午 9:00 至下午 1:00 將進行緊急備用發電機滿載測試（full-load test of the building's emergency backup generators），對應 (B) The building's auxiliary power system will undergo testing。
• 誘答分析：(D) 標準照明與電梯仍維持運作；(C) 未提送柴油；(A) 電源是在市政電網與柴油發電機間短暫切換。

questions.q: What are listeners advised to do before Friday evening?
options: Turn off delicate computing hardware
Unplug standard office lighting fixtures
Leave Northbridge Corporate Tower for ten seconds
Back up files onto the municipal network

explain.text:
• 考點：建議行動題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：建議週五傍晚離開前關閉敏感伺服器與桌上型電腦（power down sensitive server equipment and desktop workstations），對應 (A) Turn off delicate computing hardware。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 皆挪用原文 municipal、office lighting、ten seconds 製造陷阱。

questions.q: What is the main topic of the speaker's presentation?
options: Building structures using factory-assembled units
Reducing crane rental costs on downtown lots
Improving plumbing fixtures in existing hotels
Designing LED mirrors for a 12-story hotel

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：演講主軸為 modular construction techniques（模組化建築工法）與在工廠預鑄浴室模組，對應 (A) Building structures using factory-assembled units。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 均為細節詞（LED mirrors、crane、plumbing fixtures）的局部放大陷阱。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what is a key benefit of prefabricating bathroom pods offsite?
options: It doubles the number of bathrooms per floor.
It cuts job-site material scrap roughly in half.
It eliminates the need for climate-controlled facilities.
It allows trucks to use downtown laydown space.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：工廠預鑄可減少近 50% 工地建築廢棄物（reduces on-site construction waste by nearly fifty percent），對應 (B) It cuts job-site material scrap roughly in half。
• 誘答分析：(D) 市中心基地暫存空間（laydown space）極小，非卡車可使用；(C) 反而是在溫控工廠生產；(A) 180 間是總數，非每層倍增。

questions.q: What does the speaker mean when he says, "Logistics will make or break this timeline"?
options: The 12-story hotel cannot be built without extra laydown space.
Delivery trucks must arrive at the factory before the crane is set up.
Precise transport and lifting coordination is essential to staying on schedule.
Factory quality control is more important than crane schedules.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（Logistics will make or break this timeline）。
• 解析：因工地暫存空間極小，每個模組都得直接從卡車吊入核心區，故吊車與配送協調將決定工期成敗，對應 (C) Precise transport and lifting coordination is essential to staying on schedule。
• 誘答分析：(D) 未比較品管與吊車誰更重要；(A) 是需要同步協調，非沒有額外空間就無法蓋；(B) 吊車是在工地吊裝，非卡車去工廠前先設好。

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
options: To cancel a three-way call scheduled for Thursday
To inform Ms. Alvarez that Suite 305 has been leased
To check on the status of a proposed contract extension
To introduce a new asset manager for Building A

explain.text:
• 考點：來電目的題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：來電者表示追蹤上週寄出的租約續約提案（following up on the lease renewal proposal），對應 (C) To check on the status of a proposed contract extension。
• 誘答分析：(D) 資產經理是房東端原本的人員；(B) Suite 305 是保留擴充權，尚未出租；(A) 是要約週四下午三方通話，非取消。

questions.q: What change did the client request?
options: Securing priority rights to lease adjacent space later
Adding a second headquarters office in Suite 305
Drafting a formal addendum for immediate move-in
Lowering the annual rent increase for Building A

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：客戶要求明年若有擴編需求，可享有優先承租 Suite 305 的權利（adding a right-of-first-refusal option to expand into Suite 305），對應 (A) Securing priority rights to lease adjacent space later。
• 誘答分析：(D) 年租金調幅是房東想先敲定的項目，非客戶要求調降；(C) 增補條款尚未起草；(B) 是明年視成長情況擴充，非立即增設第二總部。

questions.q: What should the listener do when she returns the call?
options: Sign the lease renewal proposal sent last week
Confirm the landlord's annual rent increase figure
Submit her firm's projected staff growth numbers
Share when she is free for a joint discussion later this week

explain.text:
• 考點：請求行動題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：請對方回電告知週四下午是否有空進行三方通話（let me know your availability for Thursday afternoon so we can set up a brief three-way call），對應 (D) Share when she is free for a joint discussion later this week。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 皆挪用原文 staff grows、lease renewal proposal、annual rent increase 製造誘答。

questions.q: What is special about the building the visitors are touring?
options: It produces a surplus of electrical power each year.
It is the oldest six-story office building in the nation.
It consumes twenty percent more electricity than average offices.
Its overhanging solar roof shades the third-floor terrace.

explain.text:
• 考點：特色細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：導覽員說明這棟建築為 energy-positive，每年發電量比耗電量多出約 20%，對應 (A) It produces a surplus of electrical power each year。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文是首批認證綠建築之一，非最老；(D) 太陽能屋頂用來發電，未提遮陰露台；(C) 把多發 20% 曲解為多消耗 20%。

questions.q: How does the building regulate indoor temperatures during summer?
options: By storing cool river water on the third-floor terrace
By running chilled water through embedded floor tubing
By installing bulky air-conditioning ducts in the ceiling
By pumping rainwater onto the concrete roof

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：夏季將冰涼河水泵入埋在混凝土樓板內的冷卻管線（cool river water is pumped through cooling pipes built directly into the floors），對應 (B) By running chilled water through embedded floor tubing。
• 誘答分析：(C) 原文明確說「沒有笨重的空調風管（no bulky air-conditioning ducts）」；(D) 雨水是供室內給排水回收使用；(A) 河水非儲存在三樓露台。

questions.q: What will the group see next?
options: A facility that treats rainwater for building use
An indoor plumbing exhibition on the first floor
The overhanging solar roof above the sixth floor
The pump room connected to the local river

explain.text:
• 考點：行程預告題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：下一站前往三樓露台參觀淨化雨水供室內管線使用的中水回收室（water recycling room, which purifies rainwater for all indoor plumbing），對應 (A) A facility that treats rainwater for building use。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆挪用原文 overhanging solar roof、river、indoor plumbing 製造干擾。

questions.q: What trend in commercial real estate is discussed in the report?
options: Transforming underused workspaces into housing units
Expanding affordable housing into suburban office parks
Demolishing 1970s buildings to lower office vacancies
Employers requiring staff to return to downtown offices

explain.text:
• 考點：報導主題題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：商業地產開發商將空置市中心商辦大樓改建為住宅公寓（turning vacant downtown office towers into residential apartments），對應 (A) Transforming underused workspaces into housing units。
• 誘答分析：(D) 原文談混合辦公造成高空置率；(C) 是適應性再利用（adaptive reuse），非拆除；(B) 地點是市中心（downtown），非郊區。

questions.q: According to the report, what is a major obstacle to these projects?
options: Hybrid work has pushed residential vacancies above twenty percent.
City permits require at least fifteen percent office space.
Architects refuse to renovate buildings constructed in the 1970s.
Wide building layouts keep daylight from reaching interior rooms.

explain.text:
• 考點：阻礙細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：1970 年代商辦的深進深樓板（deep floor plates）使內部房間遠離窗戶、限制臥室採光，對應 (D) Wide building layouts keep daylight from reaching interior rooms。
• 誘答分析：(B) 15% 是平價住宅比例門檻；(A) 20% 以上是商辦空置率，非住宅；(C) 建築師是提出警告，並非拒絕翻修。

questions.q: What incentive is the city government offering developers?
options: Exemptions from natural daylight rules for bedrooms
Ten-year leases on vacant municipal office towers
Direct grants covering fifteen percent of construction costs
Faster application processing and temporary property-tax relief

explain.text:
• 考點：獎勵措施題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：市府提供加速建照審核與十年房屋稅減免（expedited permit reviews and ten-year property tax breaks），對應 (D) Faster application processing and temporary property-tax relief。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 皆錯置 fifteen percent、natural daylight、ten-year、vacant office towers。

questions.q: What is the speaker mainly explaining?
options: How to waive inspection contingencies before closing
How to conduct physical soil drilling on commercial lots
Why dry cleaners are barred from chemical warehouses
A preliminary records check for property buyers

explain.text:
• 考點：演講主旨題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：講者說明購置商用不動產前進行初步環境場址評估（initial environmental site review），透過歷史紀錄查核潛在污染風險，對應 (D) A preliminary records check for property buyers。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文明確說初期評估「不包含鑽探或實驗室檢測」；(C)(A) 錯置 dry cleaners、chemical warehouses、waiving their inspection contingency。

questions.q: Why does the speaker mention historical city directories?
options: They provide lab testing results from earlier closings.
They show whether a buyer's structural inspection is valid.
They help identify prior tenants that may have caused pollution.
They list fire insurance rates for auto repair shops.

explain.text:
• 考點：目的推論題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：查閱歷史城市名錄是為了確認過去是否有乾洗店、修車廠或化學倉庫等高風險業者營運（whether dry cleaners, auto repair shops, or chemical warehouses once operated on the property），對應 (C) They help identify prior tenants that may have caused pollution。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 皆挪用 structural inspection、lab testing、fire insurance 製造混淆。

questions.q: What does the speaker advise listeners to do if red flags appear?
options: Ask the environmental consultant to waive the contingency
Arrange for physical testing of earth and subsurface water
Cancel the closing immediately without further review
Update the fire insurance maps before signing

explain.text:
• 考點：建議行動題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：若發現警訊，建議委託進行實體土壤與地下水採樣（physical soil and groundwater sampling），對應 (B) Arrange for physical testing of earth and subsurface water。
• 誘答分析：(C) 是建議進一步檢測，非直接取消交割；(A) 原文是「在放棄檢驗條件之前」做檢測；(D) 火險地圖是歷史查核工具，非發現警訊後去更新。

questions.q: Who is the speaker addressing?
options: Site safety officers
Digital check-in app developers
Crew members working on upper metal decking
Main gate security guards

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾身分題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：講者提到「在我們上去鋼構樓板前（before we head up to the steel deck）」以及焊接支架與防墜安全帶，對象為 (C) Crew members working on upper metal decking。
• 誘答分析：(A) 安全人員是推行 App 的人；(B)(D) 挪用 digital check-in app、main gate。

questions.q: What change to the morning routine is announced?
options: Main gate badge scanning will end after today's briefing.
Arrival attendance will be logged electronically via mobile devices.
Workers must carry paper sign-in sheets to Zone B.
Evacuation drills will be held every morning on the steel deck.

explain.text:
• 考點：流程變更題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：今日起以數位報到 App 取代紙本簽到表，進場時用手機掃描識別證（scan your badge on your phone when you arrive），對應 (B) Arrival attendance will be logged electronically via mobile devices。
• 誘答分析：(C) 紙本簽到表已被取代；(A) 手機掃描識別證是今日新啟用，非結束；(D) 僅說明萬一疏散時能掌握人數，未說每天辦演習。

questions.q: What must workers do before entering Zone B?
options: Weld structural brackets to an approved anchor point
Install permanent guardrails along the open edges
Check the digital headcount with a site safety officer
Put on certified protective gear to prevent falls

explain.text:
• 考點：規定細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：進入 B 區必須穿戴合格防墜落安全帶並繫於核准錨點（put on a certified fall-arrest harness），對應 (D) Put on certified protective gear to prevent falls。
• 誘答分析：(B) 正因尚未裝設永久護欄才需穿安全帶；(A) 焊接支架是鐵工在做的事，非所有工人進場前要先焊支架；(C) 原文未要求找安全官點名。

questions.q: What service does EcoStruct Consulting provide?
options: Paying annual utility bills for commercial property owners
Manufacturing smart lighting controls for warehouses
Comprehensive efficiency retrofits and environmental audits
Issuing municipal carbon penalties to office towers

explain.text:
• 考點：服務內容題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：EcoStruct 專精於全面能源升級與永續評估（complete energy upgrades and sustainability reviews），對應 (C) Comprehensive efficiency retrofits and environmental audits。
• 誘答分析：(D) 開罰單的是市政府；(B) 只是建議安裝智慧照明控制，非製造商；(A) 只是要客戶上傳帳單做評估，非代繳水電費。

questions.q: Why does the speaker mention new municipal carbon caps?
options: To discourage owners from installing high-efficiency cooling units
To announce that city penalties have been postponed until next year
To explain why EcoStruct is raising its consulting rates in January
To highlight the financial risk of failing to cut energy usage

explain.text:
• 考點：目的推論題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：提及市府碳排上限，是為了提醒業主若不降載將面臨高額年度罰款（risk hefty annual fines），對應 (D) To highlight the financial risk of failing to cut energy usage。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(A) 皆錯置 next January、penalties、high-efficiency cooling units。

questions.q: How can listeners receive a complimentary preliminary assessment?
options: By submitting a year's worth of past energy statements online
By lowering their building's carbon emissions before January
By scheduling an on-site visit from certified engineers
By purchasing smart lighting controls through the website

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：上網並上傳過去 12 個月的水電帳單（upload your past twelve months of utility bills）即可獲免費初評，對應 (A) By submitting a year's worth of past energy statements online。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 皆挪用 certified engineers、January、smart lighting controls。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the briefing?
options: To select a new team for interior mechanical lifts
To go over the project timeline for a building development
To reschedule Titan Steel's deliveries for September
To explain why Earthworks Co. missed its March 4 target

explain.text:
• 考點：簡報目的題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：講者開場說要檢視 Harbor Tower 開發案的主施工排程（review our master construction schedule for the Harbor Tower development），對應 (B) To go over the project timeline for a building development。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆誤用 interior mechanical lifts、March 4、Titan Steel、September。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which phase is currently running two weeks ahead of schedule?
options: Phase 1
Phase 2
Phase 3
Phase 4

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽力線索 + 表格日期）。
• 解析：講者在獨白中刻意不說出「Phase 2」與「GeoStruct Ltd.」，僅提供線索「負責四月中旬里程碑（mid-April milestone）的班組昨天剛澆置完主要結構基礎，使該階段進度超前兩週」。對照表格，唯一落在四月中旬的目標日為 April 12（Foundation Work），對應 (B) Phase 2。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 皆為表格其他階段（三月、六月、九月），須聽懂線索並比對圖表才能作答。

questions.q: What does the speaker ask ClearView Facades to do?
options: Postpone interior mechanical lifts until September 15
Begin mobilizing exterior glass walls by April 12
Coordinate directly with Earthworks Co. this month
Finalize equipment-lifting schedules for autumn

explain.text:
• 考點：請求行動題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：講者請 ClearView Facades 在本月底前確認九月份的塔吊吊裝時段（confirm your tower crane hoisting slots for September），對應 (D) Finalize equipment-lifting schedules for autumn。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 皆錯置 April 12、Earthworks Co.、interior mechanical lifts。

questions.q: Who is the speaker most likely addressing?
options: Prospective tenants of Oakridge Mixed-Use Development
Architects revising the project's energy model
Financial stakeholders backing the development
Green building certification auditors

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾身分題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：講者稱呼聽眾為 partners（合夥人）並討論專案資本預算（capital budget），對應 (C) Financial stakeholders backing the development。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(B) 皆為建物相關其他角色，未在開頭被直接稱呼為投資合夥人。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which certification level is the speaker recommending for the Oakridge project?
options: Silver
Certified
Gold
Platinum

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽力線索 + 表格數值篩選）。
• 解析：講者在獨白中不直接唸出 Gold，而是給出兩項數值線索：「每年節能超過 30%（just over thirty percent in annual energy savings），同時將前期成本增幅控制在 4% 以下（keeping the upfront cost increase under four percent）」。對照圖表：Certified (14%, +1.2%) 與 Silver (22%, +2.1%) 節能未達 30%；Platinum (42%, +5.8%) 成本增幅超過 4%；唯獨 (C) Gold（31%, +3.4%）同時符合兩項條件。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 皆為圖表上其他認證等級，僅聽內容或僅看圖表皆無法確定答案。

questions.q: What does the speaker say will offset the upfront investment?
options: Lower capital budget targets for mixed-use developments
A four-year tax credit for green building certification
Stronger occupant loyalty and reduced day-to-day expenses
Selling excess energy generated by the building

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：講者指出更高的租戶留存率與更低的營運成本（higher tenant retention and lower operating costs）將在四年內完全抵銷前期支出，對應 (C) Stronger occupant loyalty and reduced day-to-day expenses。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 皆挪用 four years、capital budget、energy 製造干擾。

questions.q: Under the revised commercial lease, the tenant is ------- for all interior non-structural maintenance, including lighting fixtures and carpeting.
options: responsibly
responsibility
responsible
responsive

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析與固定搭配（be responsible for 對…負責）。
• 解析：空格前為 is，後接介係詞 for，表示「對所有室內非結構性維護負責」，應選形容詞 responsible。
• 誘答分析：(D) responsive（反應靈敏的，常搭配 to）；(B) 名詞；(A) 副詞。
• 單字補充：non-structural maintenance 非結構性維護、lighting fixture 照明燈具。

questions.q: The structural engineers conducted a thorough ------- of the load-bearing columns before approving the rooftop garden installation.
options: inspected
inspector
inspect
inspection

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（形容詞 thorough 後接名詞）。
• 解析：不定冠詞 a + 形容詞 thorough 後需單數名詞，inspection（檢查/檢驗）符合句意。
• 誘答分析：(C) 動詞原形；(A) 過去式/分詞；(B) 指人名詞「檢查員」（conduct an inspector 語意不合）。
• 單字補充：load-bearing column 承重柱。

questions.q: ------- the surge in structural steel prices during the second quarter, Vertex Builders completed the logistics hub within the original budget.
options: Although
Despite
Whereas
Because

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步介係詞 vs. 連接詞辨析。
• 解析：空格後接名詞片語 the surge in structural steel prices...（無動詞），須用介係詞 Despite（儘管）。
• 誘答分析：(A) Although、(C) Whereas、(D) Because 皆為從屬連接詞，後方須接完整子句（主詞+動詞）。
• 單字補充：surge 劇增/飆漲、structural steel 結構鋼。

questions.q: All subcontractors must submit proof of general liability insurance ------- commencing any excavation work on the Meridian Plaza site.
options: in order that
even if
prior to
as long as

explain.text:
• 考點：介係詞片語 + 動名詞（prior to + V-ing）。
• 解析：空格後為動名詞 commencing，prior to（在…之前）為介係詞片語，可接動名詞。
• 誘答分析：(A) in order that（為了）、(D) as long as（只要）、(B) even if（即使）皆為連接詞，後接子句。
• 單字補充：commence 開始、excavation work 開挖工程。

questions.q: The insulated glass windows significantly reduce heat loss, ------- lowering annual cooling costs by nearly twenty-five percent.
options: however
thereby
instead
otherwise

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞連接詞（因果轉折）與分詞構句搭配。
• 解析：逗號後接 , thereby + V-ing 表示「藉此/從而降低每年冷卻成本近 25%」。
• 誘答分析：(A) however（然而）、(C) instead（取而代之）、(D) otherwise（否則）均無法自然引導結果分詞片語。
• 單字補充：insulated glass 隔熱玻璃、heat loss 熱損失。

questions.q: Had the developer secured the building permit earlier, construction on the mixed-use complex ------- last autumn.
options: will begin
had begun
would have begun
would begin

explain.text:
• 考點：與過去事實相反的假設語氣倒裝句（Had + S + Vpp..., S + would have + Vpp）。
• 解析：句首 Had the developer secured... 等同於 If the developer had secured...，主句時間副詞為 last autumn，故選 would have begun。
• 誘答分析：(A) 未來式；(D) 與現在事實相反；(B) 時態錯置。
• 單字補充：building permit 建築許可、mixed-use complex 住商混合大樓。

questions.q: Tenants wishing to renew their five-year office leases must notify the property management office in writing no ------- than ninety days before expiration.
options: late
latest
lately
later

explain.text:
• 考點：固定比較級片語（no later than 不遲於/最晚於）。
• 解析：表示期限「不得晚於到期前九十天」，固定用 no later than。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原級；(B) 最高級；(C) 副詞「最近」。
• 單字補充：expiration 到期/期滿。

questions.q: The city council's new green building mandate requires all commercial developments exceeding 50,000 square feet ------- at least 30 percent of their power from renewable sources.
options: generating
generated
generate
to generate

explain.text:
• 考點：使役/要求動詞受詞補語（require + O + to V）。
• 解析：requires [all commercial developments exceeding 50,000 square feet] to generate...，標準 require + 受詞 + 不定詞。
• 誘答分析：(C) 原形（require that S + (should) + V 才用原形）；(A) 現在分詞；(B) 過去分詞。
• 單字補充：mandate 強制規定、renewable sources 再生能源。

questions.q: Neither the lead architect nor the mechanical engineers ------- able to explain the sudden pressure drop in the heating system.
options: has been
were
was
is being

explain.text:
• 考點：對等連接詞主謂一致（Neither A nor B 就近原則）。
• 解析：Neither... nor... 連接兩個主詞時，動詞單複數依較近的主詞 the mechanical engineers（複數）決定，故選 were。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(D) 皆為單數動詞。
• 單字補充：heating system 供暖系統。

questions.q: ------- its prime waterfront location, the vacant warehouse attracted bids from three major hospitality groups within a week of listing.
options: Given
Giving
Give
Gave

explain.text:
• 考點：介係詞用法（Given 鑑於/考量到）。
• 解析：Given + 名詞片語 置於句首表示「鑑於其絕佳的水岸地段」，為多益高頻高階介係詞。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(C) 皆無法作為「鑑於」之介係詞。
• 單字補充：prime waterfront location 絕佳水岸地段、hospitality group 旅宿集團。

questions.q: The new air-handling units operate so ------- that occupants on the adjacent floor can barely hear them running during peak hours.
options: quiet
quietness
quietly
quieter

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞修飾動詞（so + adv. + that...）。
• 解析：修飾不及物動詞 operate（運轉），須用副詞 quietly（安靜地）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 形容詞；(B) 名詞；(D) 比較級形容詞（so... that 不接比較級）。
• 單字補充：air-handling unit (AHU) 空氣處理機組、adjacent 鄰近的。

questions.q: Ms. Vance negotiated a six-month rent ------- period to allow her firm adequate time to complete interior fit-out work.
options: abundance
appraisal
concession
adherence

explain.text:
• 考點：商業地產核心字彙（rent concession 租金減讓/優惠）。
• 解析：句意為「爭取六個月的租金優惠期，讓公司有足夠時間進行室內裝修」，選 concession（讓步/優惠）。
• 誘答分析：(A) abundance 豐富；(D) adherence 遵守；(B) appraisal 鑑價。
• 單字補充：fit-out work 室內裝修工程。

questions.q: By the time the municipal inspector arrives tomorrow morning, the electrical crew ------- installing the emergency backup generator.
options: will have finished
has finished
finishes
was finishing

explain.text:
• 考點：未來完成式（By the time + 現在式..., S + will have + Vpp）。
• 解析：時間子句 By the time the municipal inspector arrives tomorrow morning 以現在式表未來時間，主句表屆時「將已完成」，選 will have finished。
• 誘答分析：(C) 現在式；(B) 現在完成式；(D) 過去進行式。
• 單字補充：backup generator 備用發電機。

questions.q: Every commercial unit in the Harborview Complex is equipped with smart sub-meters ------- allow tenants to monitor real-time energy usage.
options: that
whose
whom
what

explain.text:
• 考點：關係代名詞主格（修飾事物 smart sub-meters）。
• 解析：先行詞為 smart sub-meters（物），關係子句缺主詞，應選 that（或 which）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 受格指人；(B) 所有格；(D) what 不接在先行詞後方。
• 單字補充：sub-meter 分電表/智慧子電表。

questions.q: Because the foundation soil exhibited higher moisture content than anticipated, the engineering team recommended ------- the concrete pillars by four meters.
options: extend
extension
to extend
extending

explain.text:
• 考點：動名詞受詞（recommend + V-ing）。
• 解析：recommend 後接動作時直接用動名詞 extending（建議將混凝土基樁延長四公尺）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原形；(C) 不定詞（recommend 不接 to V，除非 recommend sb to V）；(B) 名詞 extension 後接 the concrete pilings 缺乏介係詞 of。
• 單字補充：engineering team 工程團隊、concrete pillar 混凝土柱。

questions.q: The property owner agreed to reimburse the tenant for structural upgrades, ------- that all modifications comply with current safety codes.
options: providing for
unless
provided
whether

explain.text:
• 考點：條件連接詞（provided that 只要/倘若）。
• 解析：provided (that) 相當於 on the condition that，表「只要所有修改均符合現行抗震規範」。
• 誘答分析：(A) providing for 為…做準備（後接名詞，不接 that 子句）；(B) unless 除非（語意相反）；(D) whether 是否。
• 單字補充：reimburse 補償/報銷、safety code 安全規範。

questions.q: Solar canopies installed over the surface parking lot not only generate clean electricity ------- shield parked vehicles from direct sunlight.
options: or
but also
nor
and also

explain.text:
• 考點：對等相關連接詞（not only A but also B）。
• 解析：前半句有 not only generate...，後半句須以 but also shield... 形成平行結構。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 均無法與 not only 正確搭配。
• 單字補充：solar canopy 太陽能遮陽棚、surface parking lot 平面停車場。

questions.q: To avoid costly project delays, the general contractor ordered the custom-made metal panels well in ------- of the facade schedule.
options: addition
excess
front
advance

explain.text:
• 考點：介係詞片語（in advance of 在…之前/提前）。
• 解析：well in advance of the facade schedule 表示「遠在帷幕工程進度之前就預訂」。
• 誘答分析：(A) in addition to；(B) in excess of（超過）；(C) in front of（在空間前方，不指時間提前）。
• 單字補充：custom-made 客製化的、metal panel 金屬板材。

questions.q: The newly published sustainability report outlines concrete ------- for reducing overall carbon emissions across the company's retail portfolio.
options: initial
initiatives
initiators
initiating

explain.text:
• 考點：永續字彙辨析（initiatives 倡議/具體行動計畫）。
• 解析：concrete initiatives for reducing... emissions 表示「減少碳排放的具體行動方案」。
• 誘答分析：(C) 發起人；(D) 動名詞；(A) 形容詞「最初的」。
• 單字補充：overall carbon emissions 整體碳排放。

questions.q: ------- of the two proposed layouts for the co-working floor maximizes natural daylight while preserving acoustic privacy for meeting pods.
options: All
Every
Either
Both

explain.text:
• 考點：不定代名詞主謂一致（Either of + 複數名詞 + 單數動詞）。
• 解析：後方動詞為單數 maximizes，且名詞為 the two proposed layouts（兩者），故選 Either（兩者中的任一個）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Both 搭配複數動詞；(B) Every 不接 of；(A) All 用於三者以上且搭配複數動詞。
• 單字補充：acoustic privacy 隔音隱私、meeting pod 會議艙。

questions.q: Once the occupancy permit is ------- by the Department of Building Safety, retail tenants may begin stocking their storefronts.
options: issue
issuance
issuing
issued

explain.text:
• 考點：被動語態（is issued by 由…核發）。
• 解析：主詞為 the occupancy permit（使用執照），與 issue 為被動關係，故選過去分詞 issued。
• 誘答分析：(C) 主動進行式；(A) 原形/現在式；(B) 名詞。
• 單字補充：occupancy permit 建築物使用執照、storefront 店面。

questions.q: The brokerage's quarterly market brief indicates that Class A office ------- in the central business district fell to a five-year low of 6.4 percent.
options: vacating
vacant
vacate
vacancy

explain.text:
• 考點：商業地產專有名詞（office vacancy 辦公室空置率/空置情況）。
• 解析：複合名詞 Class A office vacancy（A 級商辦空置率）作 that 子句主詞，後接動詞 fell。
• 誘答分析：(B) 形容詞；(C) 動詞；(A) 動名詞。
• 單字補充：central business district (CBD) 中央商務區。

questions.q: Concrete mixtures using recycled materials cure more slowly initially ------- achieve greater long-term structural strength.
options: thus
yet
so
for

explain.text:
• 考點：對等轉折連接詞（yet 然而/卻）。
• 解析：前半句「起初凝固較慢」，後半句「卻能達到更高的長期抗壓強度」，語意轉折且連接動詞片語 cure... yet achieve...，選 yet。
• 誘答分析：(C) so 因此；(D) for 因為；(A) thus 因此（副詞，不能直接連接兩個動詞片語）。
• 單字補充：recycled materials 回收材料、structural strength 結構強度。

questions.q: Mr. Takahashi's team was commended for ------- the historic brick facade while seamlessly integrating modern air-conditioning ducts behind it.
options: preserving
reserving
observing
deserving

explain.text:
• 考點：字彙語意辨析（preserving 保存/維護）。
• 解析：介係詞 for 後接動名詞，句意為「因保存歷史磚造立面同時無縫整合現代空調管線而受到表揚」，選 preserving。
• 誘答分析：(B) 保留/預訂；(C) 觀察/遵守；(D) 值得。
• 單字補充：historic brick facade 歷史磚造立面、air-conditioning ducts 空調風管。

questions.q: Should any hazardous materials be discovered during demolition, work in that wing must cease ------- until certified safety specialists clear the area.
options: immediately
immediate
intermediacy
immediacy

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞修飾動詞 cease（立即停止）。
• 解析：work... must cease immediately 須用副詞 immediately 修飾動詞 cease。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C) 名詞；(B) 形容詞。
• 單字補充：hazardous materials 有害物質、demolition 拆除工程。

questions.q: The lease agreement stipulates an annual rent ------- of three percent, tied to the regional consumer price index.
options: escalation
evaluation
excavation
evacuation

explain.text:
• 考點：商業租約核心字彙（rent escalation 租金調漲/遞增）。
• 解析：annual rent escalation of three percent 指「每年 3% 的租金調漲」。
• 誘答分析：(D) 疏散；(C) 開挖；(B) 評估。
• 單字補充：stipulate 規定/明訂、consumer price index (CPI) 消費者物價指數。

questions.q: ------- carefully the contractor reviewed the bid specifications, several discrepancies in the plumbing plans went unnoticed until installation began.
options: Whichever
However
Whatever
Wherever

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步副詞子句（However + adv. + S + V 無論多麼…）。
• 解析：空格後直接接副詞 carefully，表示「無論包商多麼仔細地審閱標書規範」，應選 However（= No matter how）。
• 誘答分析：(C) Whatever 接名詞；(A) Whichever 接名詞；(D) Wherever 表地點。
• 單字補充：discrepancy 差異/出入、installation 安裝工程。

questions.q: Low-odor paints and glues were specified throughout the interior renovation to ensure ------- indoor air quality for returning employees.
options: optimal
optional
opaque
optimistic

explain.text:
• 考點：永續建材字彙辨析（optimal 最佳的）。
• 解析：低氣味油漆與黏著劑是為了確保「最佳的室內空氣品質（optimal indoor air quality）」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 可選擇的；(D) 樂觀的；(C) 不透明的。
• 單字補充：low-odor 低氣味的。

questions.q: The rooftop rainwater harvesting system is capable of supplying ------- forty percent of the building's outdoor watering and flushing needs.
options: over with
out of
up to
down to

explain.text:
• 考點：數量上限介係詞片語（up to 高達）。
• 解析：supplying up to forty percent 表示「供應高達 40% 的非飲用水需求」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 從…之中；(D) 向下直到；(A) 結束。
• 單字補充：rainwater harvesting system 雨水回收系統、outdoor watering 戶外澆灌。

questions.q: All change orders exceeding $15,000 require written ------- from both the project architect and the client's asset manager.
options: authorizing
authorization
authorized
authorize

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（形容詞 written 後接名詞）。
• 解析：require written authorization 表示「需要書面授權」，選不可數名詞 authorization。
• 誘答分析：(D) 動詞；(A) 動名詞/分詞；(C) 過去分詞。
• 單字補充：change order 工程變更單、asset manager 資產經理。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: The city recently opened a new public transit station downtown.
Tenants are encouraged to turn off office monitors before leaving.
This regulation applies to both owner-occupied and multi-tenant facilities.
Previous utility bills do not need to be retained for tax purposes.

explain.text: （句子插入題）：前句規定所有超過 25,000 平方英尺的商業建築須於 5 月 1 日前申報能源與用水數據；(C)「此規範同時適用於業主自用與多租戶設施」自然補充規定適用範圍。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: Specifically
Alternatively
Consequently
Similarly

explain.text: 前句說明物業經理可授權當地公用事業公司直接上傳每月電表讀數；(B) Alternatively（或者）引出替代方案——也可手動上傳 CSV 檔案，語意與轉折完全銜接。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: with
for
at
into

explain.text: 固定搭配 qualify for...（有資格獲得…綠色稅務優惠）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: add
additionally
additional
addition

explain.text: 介係詞 with 後接名詞 penalties，須用形容詞 additional（額外的罰款）修飾。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: to enable
enables
enabled
enabling

explain.text: 前句為完整子句，逗號後接現在分詞 enabling 作結果分詞構句，意為「使我們得以進行改建」。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: Parking spaces will be allocated based on leased square footage.
The historic preservation board approved the signage colors yesterday.
Local building laws prohibit residential use on the ground floor.
They account for nearly forty percent of the building's heat loss.

explain.text: （句子插入題）：前句指出既有單層鋼框窗未達現行能源效率標準；(D)「它們佔了整棟建築近四成的熱損失」精確承接 windows（They）並說明為何必須更換。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: applied
applying
apply
to apply

explain.text: 動詞 recommend 後接動名詞作受詞，選 applying（建議塗佈反射型屋頂塗層）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: Please remember to validate your visitor parking pass at the front desk.
Our accounting department has already issued the final vendor payment.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused by yesterday's elevator outage.
Attached is the complete structural report along with preliminary energy modeling.

explain.text: （句子插入題）：信末結尾前，(D)「隨信附上完整結構報告與初步能源模擬」最符合工程師向資產管理副總裁匯報的書信結構。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: wastes
releases
pollutes
absorbs

explain.text: 字彙辨析。永續採伐的木材在其生命週期中會「吸收（absorbs）」碳，與前文鋼鐵和混凝土排放溫室氣體形成對比。(B) 釋放；(C) 汙染；(A) 浪費。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: However, commercial office vacancy rates remain elevated in suburban areas.
Therefore, landscaping costs must be factored into the initial land appraisal.
Furthermore, prefabricated wood components offer notable scheduling advantages.
Consequently, steel mills have lowered their wholesale prices this quarter.

explain.text: （句子插入題）：第一段談工程木材的減碳優勢，第二段討論工廠預製與快速吊裝；(C)「此外，預製木構件還提供顯著的工期優勢」完美扮演承上啟下的段落主題句。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: Faster assembly also translates into lower on-site labor costs and less neighborhood disruption.
Concrete foundations still require several weeks to reach full curing strength.
Interior designers often pair exposed wood beams with polished concrete floors.
Architects must carefully calculate wind loads for rooftop solar panels.

explain.text: 前句提及大型木構可縮短 25% 結構工期；(A)「更快的組裝也轉化為更低的現場人工成本與較少的鄰里干擾」進一步延伸該優點。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: restrictively
restrictive
restriction
restrict

explain.text: 空格位於動詞 navigate 與名詞片語 municipal building codes 之間，須用形容詞 restrictive（限制性的法規）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: reduced
reduce
reducing
reduction

explain.text: 連接詞 while 後省略主詞與 be 動詞，保留現在分詞 reducing 表同時進行的動作。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: Consequently, tenants should expect minimal disruption to weekday operations.
Please submit your monthly rent payment by the fifth of each month.
New bicycle racks have been installed near the south plaza entrance.
The rooftop cafe will extend its lunch hours starting next Monday.

explain.text: （句子插入題）：前句說明工程主要安排在週末與晚間 7 點至凌晨 5 點進行；(A)「因此，租戶在平日營運時應只會受到極小的干擾」為最合邏輯的推論。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: Once
Although
Whereas
Unless

explain.text: 時間從屬連接詞 Once（一旦新溫控系統安裝完成），各單位即可享有獨立分區溫控。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: as
except
due to
despite

explain.text: 連接詞 as 引導時間/伴隨子句（當我們致力於讓大樓成為更健康、更永續的職場時）。

questions.q: What is indicated about the 11th-floor space at The Kestrel Building?
options: It offers complimentary EV charging for all Central Station commuters.
Its ventilation system is scheduled for replacement next month.
Prospective tenants must commit to at least a half-decade contract.
It is split into non-adjacent suites across several levels.

explain.text:
• 考點：租期條件推論 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：廣告列明 flexible 5- to 10-year standard commercial lease terms（5 至 10 年彈性租期），對應 (C) Prospective tenants must commit to at least a half-decade contract（潛在租戶須承諾至少半個十年＝5 年合約）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 原文為 contiguous（相連整層），非分散樓層；(A) EV 充電樁為地下車庫設施，未說供車站通勤族免費使用；(B) 通風系統已近期升級完畢，非下月更換。

questions.q: What feature helps lower the building's utility expenses?
options: Light-responsive exterior glazing
Twelve Level 2 chargers in the garage
Indoor bike storage with shower facilities
Continuous 24/7 concierge lobby lighting

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：大樓升級了 smart tinted glass（智慧調光玻璃）可省下高達 35% 水電費，對應 (A) Light-responsive exterior glazing（感應光線的外部玻璃）。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆挪用原文 bike storage、24/7、concierge lobby、Level 2 chargers 製造干擾。

questions.q: Why is the concrete pour delayed?
options: The batch plant cannot deliver any mixer trucks before 11:00 A.M.
A substitute city official has yet to reach the job site.
The pump truck was sent to the wrong gate at 8:14 A.M.
The original structural inspector rejected the rebar layout at 7:30 A.M.

explain.text:
• 考點：因果細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：Liam 回報原檢查官請病假，代班人員要 10:15 A.M. 才會到場，對應 (B) A substitute city official has yet to reach the job site。
• 誘答分析：(C) 泵浦車已於 8:14 A.M. 抵達 Gate 3；(A) 是 Nora 指示延後預拌車至 11:00 A.M.，非預拌廠拒送；(D) 原檢查官請病假，根本沒到場，並沒有駁回鋼筋配置。

questions.q: What does Nora instruct Liam to do?
options: Notify the client that the pour is two hours behind
Coordinate with the supplier's scheduler to push back the shipment
Sign off on the rebar inspection before the batch plant closes
Ask the pump truck driver to wait at Gate 3 until 10:15 A.M.

explain.text:
• 考點：指示行動題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：Nora 指示 Call the dispatcher immediately and delay the first two mixer trucks until 11:00 A.M.，對應 (B) Coordinate with the supplier's scheduler to push back the shipment。
• 誘答分析：(A) 通知客戶是 Nora 自己要做（A/B 人物錯置）；(D)(C) 挪用 Gate 3、10:15 A.M.、sign off 製造誘答。

questions.q: What is forbidden on the Riverfront construction site?
options: Dry-sawing masonry materials without dust-suppression gear
Taking hydration breaks between 11:00 A.M. and 4:00 P.M.
Performing exterior facade grinding above Level 4
Working within 15 meters of active zones while wearing face masks

explain.text:
• 考點：禁止規定題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：備忘錄禁止 Dry cutting of concrete or brick 且規定須全程開啟灑水或集塵設備，對應 (A) Dry-sawing masonry materials without dust-suppression gear。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 皆將原文允許或強制執行之條件反轉為禁止項目。

questions.q: Why have cooling stations been set up on Levels 3 and 6?
options: To serve as collection points for vacuum dust collectors
To distribute protective face masks to arriving crews
To give personnel relief from unusually high temperatures
To store backup water-spray attachments near the east stairwell

explain.text:
• 考點：目的細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：因預報異常高溫（unseasonably warm weather），設置遮陰降溫站讓工人消暑，對應 (C) To give personnel relief from unusually high temperatures。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(B) 皆挪用 water-spray attachments、east stairwell、vacuum dust collectors、protective face masks 製造陷阱。

questions.q: Who must record daily adherence to the new rules?
options: Sports drink station attendants
OHS safety officers
Individual masonry cutters
Team leaders overseeing site workers

explain.text:
• 考點：責任歸屬題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：Supervisors are responsible for logging crew compliance daily，對應 (D) Team leaders overseeing site workers。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 皆為工地其他角色或設施。

questions.q: Why is Suncrest Urban Development LLC applying for a height exception?
options: To convert a Light Industrial parcel into a residential tower
To construct a facility taller than current zoning permits
To avoid the 40% green roof requirement in Room 204
To eliminate the 150 underground parking stalls from the plan

explain.text:
• 考點：申請目的題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：申請案欲在限高 55 英尺的輕工業區興建 78 英尺高的創新中心，對應 (B) To construct a facility taller than current zoning permits。
• 誘答分析：(A) 建物仍為創新中心，非改為住宅大樓；(D)(C) 150 個地下車位與 40% 綠屋頂皆為提案包含之特色，非企圖規避。

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of the proposed project?
options: Planted rooftop coverage
Subterranean vehicle stalls
On-site solar battery storage
Water-absorbing ground surfacing

explain.text:
• 考點：NOT 細節排除題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：文中提及 40% green roof coverage area（A）、150 underground parking stalls（B）、water-draining pavement（D），唯獨未提 (C) On-site solar battery storage。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(D) 均透過同義詞改寫對應原文項目。

questions.q: When is the last day for the public to submit written feedback?
options: November 14
November 16
November 18
November 24

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節題。
• 解析：書面意見截止時間為 5:00 P.M. on November 14，對應 (A) November 14。
• 誘答分析：(C) November 18 為公聽會舉行日，(B)(D) 為相近日期干擾。

questions.q: What is the main topic of the article?
options: Why suburban shopping malls face fierce community opposition
Why automated fulfillment centers prefer undeveloped land
How Pacific Institute measures landfill waste from demolition
Converting underused commercial properties into logistics facilities

explain.text:
• 考點：文章主旨題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：文章探討將業績不佳的郊區商場改建為最後一哩物流中心，對應 (D) Converting underused commercial properties into logistics facilities。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆屬過度推論或局部細節放大。

questions.q: According to Dr. Hannah Cho, how do developers significantly reduce carbon emissions?
options: By preserving key elements of the existing framework
By clearing 900,000-square-foot malls completely before rebuilding
By situating new warehouses far from highway interchanges
By limiting clear heights to between 14 and 18 feet

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：Dr. Cho 指出保留既有混凝土樓板與主要鋼構（retaining the existing concrete slab and primary structural steel）可減碳達 45%，對應 (A) By preserving key elements of the existing framework。
• 誘答分析：(B) 完全拆除會產生大量廢棄物；(C) 文章開頭即指出開發商是利用既有商場而非遠離交流道建新倉；(D) 14–18 英尺是舊商場的過低樓高。

questions.q: What engineering challenge is mentioned in the article?
options: Retaining concrete slabs increases landfill waste by 45 percent.
Original vertical clearances fall short of modern storage needs.
Upper platforms cannot be dismantled without destroying the roof.
Suburban malls lack access to established highway interchanges.

explain.text:
• 考點：挑戰細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：商場天花板僅 14–18 英尺，而現代自動化物流需至少 32 英尺淨高，對應 (B) Original vertical clearances fall short of modern storage needs。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(C) 均與原文敘述相反或過度推論（如「永久移除整個屋頂」）。

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
     "Beyond land-use advantages, the environmental benefits of salvaging structural materials are substantial."

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：插入句「除了土地利用優勢外，搶救結構材料的環境效益也很可觀」承接第一段土地優勢，並引出第二段 Dr. Cho 談保留結構減碳，故置於 [2]。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To announce that Beacon Builders met its 2030 emissions goal
To introduce updated sustainability rules for upcoming building work
To delay all slab-on-grade pours until late autumn
To terminate supply contracts with Apex Concrete and Horizon Materials

explain.text:
• 考點：信件主旨題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：信件公告 10 月 1 日起新工程須採用低碳水泥或含 25% 回收料之混合料，對應 (B) To introduce updated sustainability rules for upcoming building work。
• 誘答分析：(D) 兩家廠商是配合調整配比的夥伴，非遭汰換；(C) 僅提醒低溫下須調整配比，非全面延後；(A) 2030 年減碳 30% 是長期企業目標，非已達成。

questions.q: What caution does Mr. Alvarez give about low-carbon cement?
options: It requires a 25% increase in mixing formulas during autumn.
It fails to match the structural strength of traditional cement.
Cold weather may alter how the mixture sets early on.
It is unsuitable for commercial foundation pours below 10°C.

explain.text:
• 考點：注意事項題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：提醒在低於 10°C 時 early-stage curing behavior can vary slightly，對應 (C) Cold weather may alter how the mixture sets early on。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文說長期結構強度相當（comparable structural strength）；(A) 25% 是回收材料最低比例，非配比增幅；(D) 僅須調整配比，並非完全不適用。

questions.q: How can a project team obtain an exception to the new policy?
options: By submitting a formal exemption request ahead of the tender process
By downloading 2026_Concrete_Specs.pdf from the shared drive
By asking Horizon Materials to adjust the mixing formula
By cutting portfolio emissions by 30% before October 1

explain.text:
• 考點：流程細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：須於投標前至少三週向 Victor 辦公室提交正式豁免申請（submit a formal waiver request... at least three weeks prior to bidding），對應 (A) By submitting a formal exemption request ahead of the tender process。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆挪用 Horizon Materials、30%、2026_Concrete_Specs.pdf 製造錯誤連結。

questions.q: What is the purpose of this document?
options: To announce a mandatory audit of Summit Tech Park's utility invoices
To inform Orion Data Analytics that its Suite 200 lease is ending
To waive the $3,000 management and administrative fee
To reconcile prior-year operating charges with advance payments

explain.text:
• 考點：文件目的題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：本文件為年度 CAM 費用結算單，結算實際支出 $39,000 與預繳 $36,000 之差額 $3,000，對應 (D) To reconcile prior-year operating charges with advance payments。
• 誘答分析：(A) 帳單可供「租戶書面申請查核」，非物業通知強制稽核；(B)(C) 皆與文件事實不符。

questions.q: What percentage of Building B's space is leased by Orion Data Analytics Inc.?

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：文件標示 15% of Building Area，對應 (B) 15%。

questions.q: What will Orion Data Analytics Inc. pay per month for estimated CAM expenses next year?

explain.text:
• 考點：數值細節題。
• 解析：末段說明來年每月預估 CAM 分期款調整為 $3,250，對應 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 為去年每月預繳額；(C)(D) 為管理費分攤額與室外景觀分攤額。

questions.q: What problem does the AeroSeal system address?
options: Harmful fumes inside buildings constructed after 2005
Conditioned air escaping from faulty ductwork
Permanently blocked supply and return registers
Excessive air pressure in occupied Class A office towers

explain.text:
• 考點：問題解決題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：手冊開頭指出老舊風管漏氣高達 30%，AeroSeal 可由內而外密封裂縫，對應 (B) Conditioned air escaping from faulty ductwork。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(D) 皆錯置 registers、2005、fumes、pressurized。

questions.q: What is highlighted as an advantage of the AeroSeal process?
options: It guarantees a 30% reduction in daily tenant operations.
Technicians can apply it without tearing into overhead structures.
It operates without pressurizing the building's air ducts.
It bonds gaps wider than 15 millimeters in a single pass.

explain.text:
• 考點：產品優勢題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：文中強調不需拆除石膏板天花板（without requiring contractors to tear down drywall ceilings），對應 (B) Technicians can apply it without tearing into overhead structures。
• 誘答分析：(D) 密封上限為 15 毫米；(C) 步驟 1 仍須暫時封住出風口；(A) 30% 是漏氣率上限，非保證所有大樓都能降 30% 帳單。

questions.q: What is provided to the client once the sealing is finished?
options: Computerized documentation comparing pre- and post-treatment airflow
Replacement drywall panels for occupied zones
A guarantee of full compliance with local fire codes
A supply of certified sealing mist for future leaks

explain.text:
• 考點：產出文件題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：步驟 4 說明完工後會提供電腦產出的前後漏氣率對比證書，對應 (A) Computerized documentation comparing pre- and post-treatment airflow。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 皆挪用 compliance、drywall、sealing mist 製造陷阱。

questions.q: Why did Pendelton Green Developments receive a reduced interest rate?
options: They already obtained 55% pre-leasing prior to October 28.
The planned development incorporates top-tier sustainability features.
They uploaded all closing items ahead of the November 13 deadline.
They agreed to a fixed-price contract with Valley Commercial Bank.

explain.text:
• 考點：因果細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：因該案鎖定白金級認證並整合太陽能發電，符合永續資產利率減碼資格，對應 (B) The planned development incorporates top-tier sustainability features。
• 誘答分析：(C) 11 月 13 日是文件上傳截止日，非已提前完成；(A) 55% 預租是撥款前提條件；(D) 固定價格合約是與營造商簽訂，非銀行。

questions.q: What must Mr. Pendelton submit before funds can be released?
options: A Green Building Platinum certificate issued within 180 days
An environmental review signed by Robert Vance
Documentation confirming majority tenant commitments
Proof that the fixed-price contract covers 55% of the plaza

explain.text:
• 考點：撥款條件題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：條件 2 要求涵蓋至少 55% 可租面積的預租承諾（at least 55% of net rentable area），即過半數租戶承諾，對應 (C) Documentation confirming majority tenant commitments。
• 誘答分析：(A) 180 天內有效期的是第一階段環境審查，非白金級證書；(B)(D) 錯置人名與文件項目。

questions.q: Who should Mr. Pendelton contact to submit the closing documents?
options: Diane Cho
The Credit Committee
Robert Vance
Arthur Pendelton

explain.text:
• 考點：聯絡人題。
• 解析：末段指示請與結案專員 Diane Cho 聯繫上傳文件，對應 (A)。

questions.q: What does the new municipal policy require?
options: All downtown transit hubs must achieve 2035 climate targets next year.
Excavators and wheel loaders will be banned from public worksites.
Private builders must phase out all diesel machinery by July 1.
City-funded builds must run cleaner-powered gear for at least half of work hours.

explain.text:
• 考點：政策內容題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：明年 7 月 1 日後發包的市政工程，現場機具至少 50% 運轉時數須採用零排放設備，對應 (D) City-funded builds must run cleaner-powered gear for at least half of work hours。
• 誘答分析：(C) 僅規範市政公共工程，非私人開發商；(A) 2035 年是氣候目標年；(B) 並未禁用挖土機，而是要求改用零排放機型。

questions.q: How is the city helping smaller contractors comply with the policy?
options: By sharing the expense of fleet upgrades and portable power units
By waiving the 50% requirement for regional firms
By reimbursing 100% of electric machinery costs through the Clean Energy Fund
By wiring permanent high-voltage stations on temporary job sites

explain.text:
• 考點：補助方式題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：市府與州基金提供 40% 配對補助以協助車隊電動化及購置可攜式充電拖車，對應 (A) By sharing the expense of fleet upgrades and portable power units。
• 誘答分析：(B) 並未豁免 50% 規定；(D) 拖車為「可攜式（portable）」，非永久插座；(C) 為 40% 配對補助，非全額負擔。

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
     "However, the transition poses financial and logistical hurdles for the local construction industry."

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：插入句「然而這項轉型為當地營造業帶來財務與後勤挑戰」正好引出第三段小型包商抱怨高昂前期成本與缺乏充電設施的內容，故置於 [3]。

questions.q: Why did Claire Moreau send the e-mail?
options: To invite Daniel Park's lab team for a tour yesterday
To ask Summit Medical to pay for rooftop solar upgrades
To explain why Building 4 lacks specialized exhaust hoods
To share an updated leasing offer after a site walkthrough

explain.text:
• 考點：寫信目的題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：Claire 感謝對方昨天參訪園區並提出修訂後的租約提案，對應 (D) To share an updated leasing offer after a site walkthrough。
• 誘答分析：(A) 參訪已於昨天完成；(C)(B) 皆曲解信件內容。

questions.q: What special requirement did Summit Medical mention during the tour?
options: Five months of free rent for the lab operations team
Custom air-handling systems and auxiliary electrical support
A 2.5% annual escalation limit on a 7-year contract
Direct sub-metering for natural gas and purified water

explain.text:
• 考點：需求細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：第一段提及對方需要特殊實驗室通風與備用電力（specialized laboratory ventilation and backup power），對應 (B) Custom air-handling systems and auxiliary electrical support。
• 誘答分析：(C) 2.5% 年漲幅上限僅限 10 年期（Option B），非 7 年期；(A)(D) 皆與表格註記或信件內容相悖。

questions.q: According to the lease summary, what is the total Tenant Improvement Allowance offered under Option B?

explain.text:
• 考點：跨欄計算題。
• 解析：Option B 面積 15,000 sq. ft. × TI 補貼 $85.00/sq. ft. = $1,275,000，對應 (C)。

questions.q: What is true about Building 4?
options: Sub-metered purified water is covered by the annual base rent.
Its energy and climate-control equipment was recently modernized.
It received Green Building Gold recertification last month.
Tenants must select Option B's 10-year term to lease Suite 100.

explain.text:
• 考點：事實推論題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：信中第三段說明 Building 4 剛完成屋頂太陽能與冷卻系統升級，對應 (B) Its energy and climate-control equipment was recently modernized。
• 誘答分析：(A) 水電費由租戶按分錶自付；(D) 亦有 7 年期 Option A；(C) 黃金級認證是「下個月」才預計取得。

questions.q: In the e-mail, what does Claire Moreau offer to arrange for next week?
options: A meeting with engineering staff to assess power requirements
Another walkthrough of Suite 100 with the ownership group
An inspection of the newly installed reinforced floor drains
A negotiation session on the 3.5% market index rate

explain.text:
• 考點：主動提議題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：Claire 提議下週安排工程總監與實驗室規劃團隊開會檢視電力負載容量（review electrical load capacities），對應 (A) A meeting with engineering staff to assess power requirements。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(C) 皆挪用 ownership group、3.5%、reinforced floor drains 製造混淆。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the City Building Department's program?
options: To mitigate city heat and ease pressure on municipal drainage
To mandate roof surface replacements on existing commercial buildings
To finance 10-year maintenance contracts for municipal sewers
To certify newly constructed buildings in the Downtown District

explain.text:
• 考點：計畫目的題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：簡章旨在降低都市高溫並減少流入市政下水道的雨水逕流，對應 (A) To mitigate city heat and ease pressure on municipal drainage。
• 誘答分析：(B) 為補助獎勵計畫，非強制更換；(D) 僅限既有商用與機構建築；(C) 10 年維護合約是申請人須簽署的義務，非市府撥款給公園。

questions.q: According to the guidelines, which requirement must be met BEFORE buying green roof materials?
options: Passing a wet-weight inspection by the City Building Department
Securing written authorization prior to ordering supplies
Submitting a 10-year maintenance pact to the City Clerk
Finishing all roof surface replacement work on site

explain.text:
• 考點：資格順序題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：資格 3 規定在購買材料或動工前須先取得正式施工前核准，對應 (B) Securing written authorization prior to ordering supplies。
• 誘答分析：(C) 10 年維護合約是在「完工後」提交；(D)(A) 皆發生在購買材料之後。

questions.q: Based on Kevin Sato's e-mail and the program table, what is the maximum rebate Harbor Freight Logistics can receive?

explain.text:
• 考點：跨篇計算題。
• 解析：面積 10,000 平方英尺、基質深度 7 吋對應表格 Semi-Intensive（單價 $18.00、上限 $180,000），10,000 × $18 = $180,000，對應 (C)。

questions.q: What is indicated about the building at 310 Dockside Avenue?
options: It sits just outside the Riverfront Watershed District boundary.
Its concrete deck needs structural upgrades before July 10.
All 14,000 square feet of its roof will feature native grasses.
An outside engineering firm has verified its load-bearing capacity.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節推論題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：信中附上工程顧問 Apex Structural Group 簽章的結構載重認證，對應 (D) An outside engineering firm has verified its load-bearing capacity。
• 誘答分析：(C) 屋頂總面積 14,000 平方英尺，僅綠化 10,000 平方英尺；(A) 該建築正位於合格的 Riverfront 分區內；(B) 原文指現有混凝土屋頂板可輕鬆承受全濕重。

questions.q: Why does Kevin Sato mention June 25?
options: Apex Structural Group will stamp the load certification on June 25.
Additional stormwater calculations are due to the city by then.
He hopes to clear administrative hurdles ahead of scheduled roof work.
The 10-year maintenance agreement must be filed by that date.

explain.text:
• 考點：時間目的題 + 同義改寫。
